criteria_met: Simulation completes without raising an exception for each of at least 3 consecutive world days (TestMultidayCompletion — 3 tests)
Audit log contains entries only for tick types information_exposure, social_interaction, and relationship_shift — never T3/T5/T6/T7/T8 (TestAuditLogTickTypes — 5 tests)
Audit log entry count per day is verified: exactly 2 entries when no relationships present (T1+T2), at least 2 entries when Vega relationship present (T1+T2+conditional T4)
LLM-path entries (llm_used=True) occur in at least one day's log when mock returns successful LLM output — LLM path confirmed reachable (TestLLMPathReachable — 2 tests)
Fallback entries (llm_used=False) occur when mock simulates rejection — fallback path confirmed reachable (TestFallbackPathReachable — 2 tests)

AppraisalOutput values from LLM-path mock entries produce numerically bounded state changes — moodScore, energy, stress, socialDrive, socialFulfillment all checked in [0,100] with NaN guard (TestStateBoundsAfterSettlement — 3 tests)
simulate_day_bridged result exposes audit_log attribute containing an AppraisalAuditLog instance (TestAuditLogExposure — 6 tests)
Each AppraisalAuditEntry has a valid UTC ISO-8601 timestamp string in timestamp_iso — timezone-aware, UTC offset == 0, and recency bounds checked (TestAuditEntryTimestamp — 3 tests)
All-fallback scenario (100% route() fallback) completes without error and produces valid final state with coherent residual carry-forward (TestAllFallbackScenario — 6 tests)
issues: Minor: acceptance criterion 3 calls for entry count to 'equal the number of active ticks attempted', but test_audit_entry_count_per_day_with_relationship uses '>= 2' rather than an exact equality check for the relationship case. This is defensively correct given T4 conditionality, but is slightly looser than the literal wording of the criterion. No functional defect — the no-relationship test does use exact equality (== 2).
summary: All 30 new tests pass. Full suite of 877 tests passes with zero failures or regressions. Only the allowed file (back/tests/test_p31_t6_multiday_audit.py) was created; all forbidden files (tick_bridge.py, appraisal_router.py, appraisal_audit_log.py, engine files) are unchanged. All 9 acceptance criteria are substantively covered with non-trivial assertions.
